en.bdb: Impotent are they who have no Guru
Wearing five garments one may assume the garb of a male person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਛਾ ਦਾੜ੍ਹੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਰਬਲ ਵੇਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: muchhaa dhaaRhee sohanee bahu dhurabal vesu|

en.bdb: He may have beautiful beard and moustaches and a slim body.
Wielder of a hundred weapons he may be counted among prominent knights.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਹਰੁ ਦੜ ਦੀਬਾਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: maahar dhaR dheebaan vich jaanai sabh dhesu|

en.bdb: He may be an adept courtier and widely known throughout the country.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਗਣਿ ਪੁਰਖਤੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਿ ਕਰੇਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: purakh na gan purakhat vin kaaman k karesu|

en.bdb: But without masculinity, of what use is he to a woman?

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਦਾਇਦੇ ਕਉਣ ਕਰੈ ਅਦੇਸੁ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: vin gun guroo sadhaidhe kaun karai adhes ||11||

en.bdb: Who would bow before those who are without merit and get themselves called Guru
